//Logging: Every value under LogLevel must parse as a log level -- the //comment convention used elsewhere in this file throws at startup there. WorldSession at Trace logs every non-movement opcode a client sends; Debug is enough for the quest conversation on its own.

WorldServer.//RealmId: Must match the realmlist row the client picked, or the handshake is rejected.
WorldServer.//ConnectionString: Empty means the local Docker default. WOWEMU_AUTH_CONNECTION overrides it.
WorldServer.//DataDirectory: Extracted client data. Relative paths resolve from the binary, so ../../../../../data reaches the repo root from bin/Debug/net10.0.
WorldServer.//IgnoreAutoAccept: Quests.IgnoreAutoAccept. false matches a stock realm: a quest flagged auto-accept goes into the log when its window opens, because the client reads the same flag and never sends an accept for it. true makes the client ask first, and diverges from upstream.
